notes: Source rig was an IK control rig: hands, feet and the head were children of the root (driven by IK targets). They were re-parented (Hand -> Forearm, Foot -> Calf, Head -> Neck), the IK/pole/face-UI control bones removed and the clips re-baked onto the cleaned hierarchy. Rest pose rebuilt from the bind pose (a clean T-pose; the file's node pose was an animation frame). Long snout: Head -> Top_Jaw (upper snout) -> Nose_1 -> Nose_2; Bottom_Jaw is the lower jaw. Eyelid and eyeball bones are kept (big cartoon eyes). Hands have 4 fingers. Facing +Z (glTF/Godot), +Y up, metres; soles at y=0, centred between the feet. Top of skull at y=1.150 (ears/hats excluded), crown point (x -0.000, y 1.150, z -0.081); head width 0.429 m, depth 0.253 m; head bone origin at (x -0.000, y 0.864, z -0.033). Rest pose T (upper arm 2 deg below horizontal). 63 bones, 9480 triangles. Bone local axes follow Blender's convention (+Y along each bone towards its child).
